features.name: Artificer's Lore
features.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

features.name: Tinker
features.description: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP) that ceases to function after 24 hours (unless you spend 1 hour repairing it). You can create a Clockwork Toy, Fire Starter, or Music Box using this trait.
